question: Should openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress" become a supported public Plugin SDK contract for cross-plugin progress presentation?
rationale: The Slack fix needs a plugin-neutral producer-to-channel signal, but exporting that signal commits OpenClaw to an external API whose permanence and semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor and document the contract
options.body: Keep the narrow generic kind and predicate, document producer and channel obligations, and require exact-head integration proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Pause the public exports and redesign an internal or broader typed presentation seam before landing the Slack suppression behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and document the contract
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow generic kind and predicate, document producer and channel obligations, and require exact-head integration proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both Slack delivery ownership and integration of Codex runtime changes, covering the two sides of the contract decision.
